n: SikaRoof VersiJack Bearer Holder Single Wing

d.t: BEARER HOLDER FOR HEIGHT-ADJUSTABLE PEDESTAL SYSTEM FOR RAISED DECKING FLOORING
d.s: SikaRoof VersiJack Bearer Holder Single Wing is an accessory used to connect timber joists to the pedestal for receiving decking boards. Bearer holders are manufactured from recycled polypropylene (PP), and it has a single wing to allow screwing into a timber joist. SikaRoof VersiJack Bearer Holder Single Wing is used in conjunction with SikaRoof VersiJack and timber joists, and is installed between the pedestal and the joists with the timber screws.
a: Resistant to biological attack by moulds and algae
Chemically resistant to acids, alkalis, oils and soil chemicals
Operates within a wide service temperature range
us: Bearer holder for raised decking installations on podiums, balconies, roof terraces and areas with hardscape finishes.

sec.t: Singapore Green Building Product (Leader) Cert. No. SGBP 3254
No expiration date if the product is stored in accordance to the storage conditions as stated in this Product Data Sheet.
Product must be stored in their original packing, and under cool and dry conditions. The product must be protected from direct sunlight, rain, snow and ice, and any other elements.
